name: Palm-sugar cake
summary: Bánh bò thốt nốt is the sweet Vietnam Tourism names when you want sugar in Châu Đốc, from the palms on the plain. VnExpress says the cake uses palm sugar and palm-fruit-shell flour with rice flour and coconut milk, and that the Bảy Núi version tastes most like itself in Châu Đốc. Eat it as a snack, a dessert, or with thịt khìa or roast pork.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s place page, for Châu Đốc. The An Giang portal, 21 Aug 2024, ties palm sugar, palm juice, and this cake to the Bảy Núi. VnExpress on 26 Apr 2024 says the truest plate is in Châu Đốc.
texture: VnExpress says the cake is usually a handsome yellow. A finer crumb was not described on the Vietnam Tourism place page.
howToEat: As a snack when you want something sweet. Vietnam Tourism does not print a texture beyond the name.
VnExpress says eat it as a mid-morning bite, a dessert, or beside thịt khìa or roast pork. The palms stand on the roads out of the center, on the same handbook.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: In town, and toward Núi Sam, where Vietnam Tourism’s charms chapter puts the palms. VnExpress does not name a shop. Check on arrival.
